CustomField.description: Semicolon separated Emirates IDs that may reserve while Exploration_Mode__c is on, for proving the live booking and signing path before the site opens. Blank means nobody and NO WILDCARD is accepted, unlike the signing allowlist. Exploration mode itself is untouched: the viewing-only banner stays up for everyone, including these applicants. Set by hand for a test window and cleared immediately after, then read back to confirm it is clear. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Exploration Bypass Emirates Ids
